messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "your treatment may also include counseling or other treatments"
set: ["your treatment may also include counseling or other treatments", "treatment may include diet", "treatment may include exercise", "your treatment may include a special diet", "your treatment may also include diet, exercise, weight control, and blood tests", "treatment may include blood tests", "treatment may include weight control", "counseling", "your treatment may also include diet, exercise, weight control, medical tests, and special medical care", "dose adjustments or alternative treatments may be available", "include rifampin", "tell doctor if also use insulin or other oral diabetes medications", "tell your doctor if you also use", "your heart and blood pressure may also need to be checked often", "may also need to shake your albuterol device just before each use", "this may happen especially at the beginning of your treatment"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
